https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24678123/g.title: 'DESPICABLE GREED' Greedy son and wife jailed after fleecing parents of £117,000 — leaving them with 28p
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24678123/g.subtitle: Gary Mansell and partner Diane used his parents as a cash cow from 2017 to 2020
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24678123/g.text:
A GREEDY son and his wife who fleeced his ­parents of £117,000 in savings have been jailed.
Gary Mansell, 61, and partner Diane, 58, used them as a cash cow from 2017 to 2020 after gaining power of attorney.
The couple left elderly Fred and Enid Mansell with 28p and living on ready meals while they spent on a £25,000 kitchen, an eternity ring, cosmetic dental work and handbags.
They also jetted off on lavish holidays - including a 14-day £7,900 break in Jamaica and a £4,000 holiday at Cape Verde.
The Mansells did so by under-selling the pensioner’s £255,000 home by about £100,000 by shifting it privately so they could get their hands on the cash.
They'd also encouraged the elderly couple to move into their home, and let them have power of attorney.
Charlotte Atherton, prosecuting, told the Liverpool Crown Court: “Fred believed that his son and wife would look after him and Enid so that they didn’t have to go into a care home in their old age."
But instead, the elderly couple was rinsed of their cash by their only son - Gary.
Judge David Swinnerton told the court: “You were both of good character but this is the most despicable display of greed, vanity and selfishness so you could live a lifestyle well beyond your means."
Mansell, of Woolton, Merseyside, had been a £95,000-a-year boss at Jaguar Land Rover.
His wife ran a curtain business until she was made bankrupt.
They lived a comfortable lifestyle in an upmarket suburb but had always dreamed of being millionaires, a court heard.
The Judge told the court: “For many people that would be a decent income on which you could live a good life but it doesn’t appear to be enough for you and Diane.”
They were convicted of fraud by abuse of position and money laundering last month.
Gary and Diane Mansell were convicted of fraud by abuse of position and money laundering following a trial last month.
Jailing them for six years each, Judge Swinnerton said: “This is the most despicable display of greed, vanity and selfishness.
“You showed them very little care, they were a cash cow for you to enable you to live that lifestyle.
“You had a position of responsibility, power and trust - all of which was grossly breached by you."
Mansell showed no response when he was told he'd be locked up but he and Diane started crying after he blew her a kiss through the video link screens.

Enid passed away in December of last year, and Fred now lives in a care home.
He described the last few months of his wife’s life as “horrible and traumatic".
